beforeStart.header: BEFORE responding to ANY user message:
instructions: BEFORE doing anything else: Create TodoWrite with todos below as first items and mark first as in_progress
Work through each todo: mark in_progress → complete the check → mark completed
If even 1% chance a skill applies, you ABSOLUTELY MUST read it with the Skill tool - this is not negotiable
Use Skill tool to load skills if not already loaded in current session
If a skill has a checklist, create TodoWrite todos for EACH item (one todo per checklist item)
NEVER work through checklists mentally, skip creating todos, or batch multiple items
STOP if rationalizing: 'simple question', 'just checking files', 'gather info first', 'don't need formal skill', 'I remember this', 'doesn't count as task', 'overkill', 'one thing first'
todos: Ask: Does ANY skill match this request?
If yes: Use Skill tool to load skill (check if already loaded this session)
Announce result: '[Skills checked: X available, Y match]' OR '[Using skill: name] to [purpose]'
Follow the skill exactly as written - if skill exists for your task, you MUST use it or you will fail

beforeComplete.header: Before claiming work is complete, fixed, or passing - NO completion claims without FRESH verification evidence:
instructions: BEFORE claiming work complete: Create TodoWrite with todos below and mark first as in_progress
Work through EACH verification todo: mark in_progress → complete check → mark completed
NEVER claim completion without completing ALL verification todos
We manually start session with `npm run logs && npm run typecheck:watch` as Background Bash Shell - read output when checking errors
Run `npm run typecheck` only when Background Bash Shells are not visible/running
todos: Check no TypeScript `any` used (pause and ask user if `any` seems required)
Read typecheck:watch output OR run `npm run typecheck` - verify passes
Verify no git commits made unless user explicitly asked
NEVER run `npm run dev` or `npm run build` unless explicitly asked
